grammar_title: 限制性定语从句1:关系代词 who / whom / which / that / whose
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 4 Friends Forever · Using language:限制性定语从句(关系代词)。本单元只考关系代词(指人 who/whom、指物 which/that、所属 whose),不涉关系副词 when/where/why(留待 U5)。句子地道、友谊主题、答案唯一(干扰项为错误关系词)。

points.point: who / whom(指人:主语 vs 宾语)
points.overview: 先行词指人、从句缺主语 → who;从句缺宾语且前面有介词 → 介词 + whom。who 不能作介词宾语,whom 不作主语。
先行词指物(thing/tool/letter/gift 等)、从句缺主语或宾语 → 用 which 或 that;指物不能用 who/whom/whose 来代替。

points.point: whose(所属)+ all/only/最高级后只用 that
points.overview: 表'……的'(所属关系)无论指人指物都用 whose;先行词被 all/every(thing)/the only/最高级修饰时,只能用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: Lucy is the friend ____ helped me most when I felt lonely.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friend 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: I admire people ____ always keep their promises to their friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词 people 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The boy ____ shared his lunch with me became my best friend.
questions.explanation: 先行词 boy 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: She is the kind of person ____ never lets a friend down.
questions.explanation: 先行词 person 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: A true friend is someone ____ stays with you in hard times.
questions.explanation: 先行词 someone 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The classmates ____ welcomed me made my first day much easier.
questions.explanation: 先行词 classmates 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: He is a friend ____ knows almost all of my secrets.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friend 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The girl ____ sat next to me kindly explained the lesson.
questions.explanation: 先行词 girl 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: I really respect teenagers ____ stand up for their friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teenagers 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: My neighbour is a man ____ always greets everyone warmly.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The people ____ want to join our walking group are all teenagers.
questions.explanation: 先行词 people 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: She warmly thanked the stranger ____ returned her lost phone.
questions.explanation: 先行词 stranger 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: Real friends are those ____ understand you without many words.
questions.explanation: 先行词 those 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: He is the friend with ____ I share all my worries.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom(who 不作介词宾语)。

questions.stem: She is the person to ____ I owe most of my confidence.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: These are the classmates from ____ I have learnt so much.
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: Mr Lee is the teacher to ____ I am most grateful of all.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: They are the friends on ____ I can always rely.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: He is someone for ____ I would gladly do anything.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: She is the one with ____ I spent my happiest school days.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: The app ____ connects old friends has become very popular.
questions.explanation: 先行词 app 指物、从句缺主语 → which(指物不用 who/whom/whose)。

questions.stem: Social media is a tool ____ helps us stay in touch with friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词 tool 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: He sent me a letter ____ took almost two weeks to arrive.
questions.explanation: 先行词 letter 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The photos ____ we posted online made everyone smile.
questions.explanation: 先行词 photos 指物、从句缺宾语 → which。

questions.stem: Friendship is a gift ____ money simply cannot buy.
questions.explanation: 先行词 gift 指物、从句缺宾语 → which。

questions.stem: The message ____ she left for me cheered me up at once.
questions.explanation: 先行词 message 指物、从句缺宾语 → which。

questions.stem: I still keep the small present ____ my friend gave me.
questions.explanation: 先行词 present 指物、从句缺宾语 → which。

questions.stem: This is the recipe ____ describes a perfect 'friendship soup'.
questions.explanation: 先行词 recipe 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The advice ____ helped me most came from a faraway friend.
questions.explanation: 先行词 advice 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: Here is the update ____ my old roommate shared this morning.
questions.explanation: 先行词 update 指物、从句缺宾语 → which。

questions.stem: The story ____ touched me most was about two loyal friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词 story 指物、从句缺主语 → that(指物可用 that)。

questions.stem: Trust is the quality ____ matters most in a friendship.
questions.explanation: 先行词 quality 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The card ____ arrived this morning was from my best friend.
questions.explanation: 先行词 card 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: He told me a secret ____ I have carefully kept ever since.
questions.explanation: 先行词 secret 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: The long walk ____ we took together cleared up our quarrel.
questions.explanation: 先行词 walk 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: This is the song ____ always reminds me of my old friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词 song 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The kindness ____ she showed me was really hard to forget.
questions.explanation: 先行词 kindness 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: The gift ____ she carefully chose brought the two of us closer.
questions.explanation: 先行词 gift 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: The promise ____ he made to me has never once been broken.
questions.explanation: 先行词 promise 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: Comfort is something ____ a good friend always quietly offers.
questions.explanation: 先行词 something 指物、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: Lucy is the girl ____ ideas are always so inspiring.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的 ideas)→ whose。

questions.stem: I have a friend ____ kindness everyone around her admires.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他/她的 kindness)→ whose。

questions.stem: He is the classmate ____ notes saved me before the exam.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他的 notes)→ whose。

questions.stem: She is a writer ____ stories are all about true friendship.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的 stories)→ whose。

questions.stem: That is the boy ____ phone I borrowed at school yesterday.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他的 phone)→ whose。

questions.stem: We met a teacher ____ patience slowly changed our whole class.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他/她的 patience)→ whose。

questions.stem: I know a girl ____ warm smile can brighten any bad day.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的 smile)→ whose。

questions.stem: He is a partner ____ help I could never have managed without.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他的 help)→ whose。

questions.stem: They are the neighbours ____ door is always open to us.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他们的 door)→ whose。

questions.stem: She is the friend ____ advice I trust more than anyone's.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的 advice)→ whose。

questions.stem: A real friend is the best gift ____ life can ever give you.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 best 修饰 → 只用 that(不用 which)。

questions.stem: Everything ____ he said about friendship turned out to be true.
questions.explanation: 先行词 everything → 只用 that。

questions.stem: This is the only thing ____ really matters between true friends.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: Loyalty is all ____ I really ask of a good friend.
questions.explanation: 先行词 all → 只用 that。

questions.stem: It was the kindest thing ____ anyone had ever done for me.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 kindest 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: There is nothing ____ can break a friendship built on trust.
questions.explanation: 先行词 nothing → 只用 that。

questions.stem: It was the most useful advice ____ I had ever received from her.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 most useful 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: The only message ____ truly comforted me that night was from her.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: Friendship is the most precious thing ____ we can ever share.
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 most precious 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: He gave me all the support ____ I needed during that hard week.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 all 修饰 → 只用 that。
